report.seo.title: Visibility in Google
report.seo.honesty: Google cannot crawl a local (localhost) site; this section measures launch readiness and technical SEO fitness and does not guarantee rankings, which depend mostly on content quality and external links. Google uses field data (CrUX, p75) for Core Web Vitals; only lab/heuristic measurements are available here.
report.seo.heuristic: The performance sub-score is heuristic (static signals); lab Core Web Vitals will come with the browser module.
report.seo.capped: A critical indexing blocker caps the SEO score at 40.
report.seo.post.1: Add and verify the property in Google Search Console.
report.seo.post.3: Request indexing of the main pages with URL Inspection.
report.seo.post.4: Monitor the 'Page indexing' and 'Core Web Vitals' reports.
report.seo.post.5: Add the site to Bing Webmaster Tools as well.
report.seo.post.6: Keep monitoring broken links and 404 errors.
report.seo.post.7: If you are a local business, create a Google Business Profile.
